content:
The image shows a mango leaf with multiple small, dark brown spots scattered across the surface. The spots appear irregular and oval-shaped, distributed across the leaf blade. The leaf margins show some browning/necrosis as well.

Key observations:
- Small dark brown irregular spots spread across the leaf surface
- Spots appear sunken/flat, not raised
- Some marginal necrosis visible
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty encrustation (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No gum secretion or twig withering visible (rules out Die Back)
- The irregular oval spots scattered across the leaf surface match Anthracnose description: "Irregular, oval-shaped spots all over the leaf surface"
